name: CN Natural Sort
description: Sorts the file explorer with Chinese-aware natural ordering, so 第一章, 第二章 and 第十章 appear in numeric order. Arabic, Chinese and Roman numerals are compared by value, including multi-level names like 笔记（二）：第一单元. No renaming, no content edits, zero configuration — it hooks the explorer's own sort routine.
author: liu-li-huan-ying
